Question

Let’s say you want to make a spirolateral.

If the turn angle is \(117^{\circ}\) and the maximum segment length is \(9\), then which spirolateral is created?

You can use this tool:

https://artockthedino.github.io/pbl/spirolateral/spirolateral_generator.html


Answerlist

  • A
  • B
  • C
  • D
  • E
  • F
  • G
  • H

Solution

The correct answer is B.

Below I’ve listed the parameters used to generate all patterns:

  • A:
    • Turn angle = 162
    • Count max = 18

  • B:
    • Turn angle = 117
    • Count max = 9

  • C:
    • Turn angle = 138
    • Count max = 12

  • D:
    • Turn angle = 165
    • Count max = 11

  • E:
    • Turn angle = 45
    • Count max = 11

  • F:
    • Turn angle = 150
    • Count max = 15

  • G:
    • Turn angle = 55
    • Count max = 17

  • H:
    • Turn angle = 150
    • Count max = 10
